title: Conditional Types & Type Inference
description: Master conditional types, infer keyword, template literal types, and advanced type-level programming.

data.text: Conditional types select types based on conditions. Use the infer keyword to extract types from other types. Template literal types enable string manipulation at the type level.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Conditional types select types based on conditions
infer keyword extracts types from other types
Template literal types manipulate strings at type level
Distributive conditional types work with unions
Type inference enables automatic type deduction
data.takeaway: Conditional types and type inference enable powerful type-level programming. Use them to build sophisticated type systems that catch errors at compile time.
